description: This file is a shell script that contains test cases and commands for testing the 'git show-branch' functionality in the Git version control system. It sets up repositories, runs various 'git show-branch' commands with different options, and checks their outputs against expected results.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case that expects the enclosed commands to succeed.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Runs commands expecting them to fail, used to verify error handling.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares the output of commands to expected output files.

methods.name: test_config
methods.description: Sets or checks git configuration variables for testing.

methods.name: test_must_be_empty
methods.description: Ensures the output of a command is empty.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers cleanup actions to run after tests.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Checks for specific patterns in output.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.
